bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --version >/dev/null
db="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(postgres|database|db-[0-9])' | head -n1)"
test -n "$db" || exit 81
docker exec "$db" sh -c 'command -v psql >/dev/null && test -n "$POSTGRES_USER" && test -n "$POSTGRES_DB"' || exit 82
docker exec "$db" sh -c 'psql -qAt -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SELECT 1"' | grep -qx 1 || exit 83
echo VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_DB_READONLY=PASS
